rows.basis: The FY2025 MD&A says AI and high-performance computing are driving increased demand for hyperscale and data-center cooling, but it gives no dollar figure or share. JCI's segments (Americas $15.831B, EMEA $4.968B, APAC $2.797B) are regions, not a data-center line, so they are not summed. The high-teens data-center share comes from a call, not a release or filing, and covers fiscal 2026. Data center is also broader than AI.
The pack has no FY2024 statement linking revenue to AI or data centers. The FY2024 segments (Building Solutions North America, EMEA/LA, Asia Pacific, Global Products) are not data-center lines.
The pack has no FY2023 statement linking revenue to AI or data centers. The segments are regional or product-based, not data-center lines.
The pack has no FY2022 statement linking revenue to AI or data centers. The segments are regional or product-based, not data-center lines.
